comments.author: saksarav-nokia
comments.body:
SAI sends port state change notifications with status=down for all the front panel and fabric ports as soon as the switch create is complete and even before the SAI discovery is complete. So swss and syncd are not aware of the port object Id's and logs these errors.
Created BCM csp CS00012440300

comments.author: saksarav-nokia
comments.body:
As per BCM, they corrected the sequence in SAI 14.1 as per the following update from them. However this triggers lot of syslog messages since the Port change notification is received in sonic from SAI even before SAI discovery is done.


Register the link scan callback.
Enable the link scan.

In version 13.2.1, this sequence was incorrect. Consequently, the callback was not triggered, even though the test component registered the notification during the switch creation process.

Also note that link event down notification during linkscan enable for all ports are expected as per the SDK JIRA SDK-448029:

"Once linkscan is enabled, or a port is new-add to linkscan, we can't know previous linkstatus. So if current link is down, linkscan will notify user current status."

linkedPullRequests.title: Reduce port snoop notification log level from NOTICE to INFO
linkedPullRequests.author: knucklesal
linkedPullRequests.body:
## Description
Reduces the log level of port snoop notifications in the SAI meta layer from `NOTICE` to `INFO`.

### Why
SAI 14.1 corrected the link scan callback sequence (was broken in 13.2.1). Now SAI correctly sends port state change notifications (link down) immediately after switch create, before orchagent has finished creating/discovering ports. The meta layer's snoop mechanism handles this correctly by auto-discovering the ports, but logs at `NOTICE` level for each one.

On chassis platforms (BCM DNX) with 100+ front panel and fabric ports, this produces excessive syslog noise at boot:
```
```

### What changed
- `meta_sai_on_port_state_change_single()`: `SWSS_LOG_NOTICE` → `SWSS_LOG_INFO`
- `meta_sai_on_port_host_tx_ready_change()`: `SWSS_LOG_NOTICE` → `SWSS_LOG_INFO`

The snoop mechanism continues to work identically — only the log level changes. Messages remain available at INFO level for debugging.

### Precedent
The existing `post get` snoop at line 5630 already uses `META_LOG_INFO` for the same pattern.

Fixes: sonic-net/sonic-buildimage#24871

linkedPullRequests.title: [submodule] Update sonic-sairedis: reduce port snoop log noise (#24871)
linkedPullRequests.author: knucklesal
linkedPullRequests.body:
## Description
Updates the `sonic-sairedis` submodule to include a fix that reduces port snoop notification log level from `NOTICE` to `INFO` in the SAI meta layer.

### Problem
On BCM DNX chassis platforms running SAI 14.1, port state change notifications arrive immediately after switch create — before orchagent creates ports in the meta layer's local DB. The meta snoop mechanism correctly auto-discovers the ports, but logs at `NOTICE` level for each one:
```
```
On chassis with 100+ front panel and fabric ports, this produces excessive syslog noise at every boot.

### Root Cause
SAI 14.1 corrected the linkscan callback registration sequence (broken in 13.2.1, per BCM CSP CS00012440300). Now SAI correctly sends link-down notifications for all ports during linkscan enable, which is expected SDK behavior (SDK JIRA SDK-448029).

### Fix
Change `SWSS_LOG_NOTICE` → `SWSS_LOG_INFO` in two functions in `meta/Meta.cpp`:
- `meta_sai_on_port_state_change_single()` — port oper status notifications
- `meta_sai_on_port_host_tx_ready_change()` — port host TX ready notifications

The snoop mechanism continues to work identically. Messages remain available at INFO level for debugging.

### Submodule PR
- sonic-net/sonic-sairedis#1800

Fixes: #24871
